subject: Mutual Action Plan — runway realignment & procurement hold
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Ramos <sasha.ramos@novasol.com>, Linda Chen <linda.chen@novasol.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Prriyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — runway realignment & procurement hold

Hi Sasha / Linda —

Quick update from our side after the call this morning. Thank you for walking through the SOC2 evidence timeline — understood that procurement is pausing PO issuance until the external security review completes (target ~Oct 21). That creates a risk to the close date we had in the MAP (original close: Oct 30).

Proposed immediate steps so we keep momentum without overcommitting:
- Share an updated MAP (attached v3) with revised milestones and single-point owners.
- Request a short SLA exception for production uptime SLA to be applied post-PO, but allow access to a dedicated test pool for performance validation.
- Offer one-week onboarding support and a 10% credit if Novasol signs within 10 business days of procurement clearance (to keep economic alignment).

Action items for us (internal): Laura to draft the SLA-exception note, Prriyom to update the MAP and timeline, Monica to prepare a condensed evidence packet for the security reviewers.

Sasha / Linda — can you confirm if your procurement hold is strictly PO issuance, or are there additional legal redlines expected by Oct 21? That will change whether we should aim for a Nov 15 close vs. pushing to Dec.

Thanks,
Karthik

[Attachment: MAP_Novasol_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sasha Ramos <sasha.ramos@novasol.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Linda Chen <linda.chen@novasol.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novasol.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — runway realignment & procurement hold

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and for the MAP v3. Short answer: procurement is pausing PO issuance pending the external security checklist; legal has flagged two additional items (data residency language and a shorter liability cap) that they most likely will redline. Those conversations usually take another 7–10 business days after the security signal is clear.

For us, the target close is moving: Oct 30 is optimistic. Realistically we are looking at a Nov 15–30 window unless we fast-track the legal reviews. We appreciate the credit offer; procurement would prefer that any commercial concession sits in the SOW rather than a retro credit.

I'll confirm procurement's earliest possible PO date by EOD Oct 12.

—Sasha

[Procurement thread attached by procurement@novasol.com]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Prriyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Draft SLA-exception + rapid legal handoff

Team —

Draft notes for the SLA exception (attached Proposed-SLA-exception.md). Key points: allow Novasol access to a dedicated test cluster with read-only telemetry for performance validation; production SLA to commence upon issuance of the PO or upon acceptance of the final SOW (whichever occurs first). We should avoid unconstrained credits; propose a capped onboarding credit (max $15k) as a good-faith commercial.
